dreams.text: The machine sleeps and sees CUP priced in WINTER, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of VIDEO devouring ICE, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where GOOGLE forgets it was ever about SUPER.
Far ahead, VENEZUELA and ANTHROPIC merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, WAR is law and FILM is myth.
In the dream, VIDEO crosses every chasm at once and finds ICE already there.
